Bihar MLC Election Result: tirhut snatak sit par 17ven raund ki ginti ke bad banshidhar brajvasi ne 31,832 vot hasil kar ek bari jit darj ki hai. pratidvandi abhishek jha ko kul 22,685 vot mile, jiske chalte brajvasi ne unhen 9,147 maton ke bare antar se shikast di.
